hints: You are producing two runs, in order, and then joining them. What is the least bookkeeping that lets you build both at once?
Two chains built side by side as you walk: one for the links below the pivot, one for the rest. Order is preserved automatically because you append in the order you meet them.
Each of the two needs a tail to append to and has no head yet - which is exactly what a dummy link is for. Two dummies, two tails.

When the walk ends, join the two: point the lower tail at the upper chain's first real link, and terminate the upper tail - or the old links still point into the middle of the chain and you have a loop.
